description: Fetch chain sequences from RCSB PDB with protein/nucleotide classification

input_schema.description:
Input for PDB FASTA chain fetch.

Attributes:
    pdb_id (str): PDB accession (e.g. '1LBG').
input_schema.title: PdbFetchFastaInput

config_schema.description: Configuration for PDB FASTA fetches (no user-facing settings).

verbose.description: Verbosity level (0=quiet, 1=info, 2=debug, 3=raw subprocess stderr). True→1, False→0.
verbose.title: Verbose

timeout.description: Maximum execution time in seconds. None waits indefinitely.
timeout.title: Timeout

seed.description: Random seed for reproducible results. Some cacheable tools gate cache on this field.
seed.title: Random Seed

config_schema.title: PdbFetchFastaConfig

PdbChain.description:
Single entity from PDB FASTA (one record = one unique sequence).

Attributes:
    chain_ids (list[str]): Author-assigned chain identifiers sharing this sequence
        (typically multi-element for homo-oligomers).
    header (str): Full FASTA header line.
    sequence (str): Chain sequence string.
    is_protein (bool): True if protein, False if nucleic acid.

chain_ids.description: Author-assigned chain IDs sharing this sequence
chain_ids.title: Chain IDs

is_protein.description: True if protein, False if nucleic acid
is_protein.title: Is Protein

PdbChain.title: PdbChain

output_schema.description:
Output from PDB FASTA chain fetch.

Attributes:
    chains (list[PdbChain]): Parsed chain sequences with protein/nucleotide classification.
    source_url (str | None): URL used for the request.
output_schema.title: PdbFetchFastaOutput
